reviews.comment:
Pésima atención, antes de cargarnos le dijimos necesito factura A y pago con la aplicación. Obvio q nos dijo que ok y cargo. Una vez que estaba hecha la carga, no dice que no nos da factura por pagar con app.
Osea que hizo lo que se le canto y eso que fuimos claros antes de empezar la carga

(Translated by Google)
Terrible service. Before charging our phone, we told them we needed an invoice and would pay with the app. Of course, they said okay and charged us. Once the charge was complete, they told us they wouldn't give us an invoice because we were paying with the app.
So they did whatever they wanted, even though we were clear about that before starting the charge.
